editorial:
Imagine having your entire neighborhood mapped out and under control, only for a strange new neighbor to ruin everything. That is exactly what happens to Alli and Jane, two kids who think they know every secret in town. When their strict school principal moves in right next door, things get weird very quickly. You will love the vibe of this movie because it feels like a classic childhood adventure where the adults are clueless and the kids are the only ones seeing the truth. It captures that feeling of summer boredom turning into a full-blown investigation, making you feel like you are part of their little detective club.

The best part is how the mystery builds up without feeling too slow. The kids have great chemistry, and the twists are surprising enough to keep you guessing until the end. While some of the late 90s effects look a bit dated, the story is strong enough that you will not even care. If you are looking for a cozy family night, you should definitely check this out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick watch, but if you love physical media, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your collection is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: The big reveal happens when Alli and Jane discover the principal is actually hiding a secret map in his basement. They find out he was not trying to be mean, but was searching for a lost local treasure. In the final scene, the kids help him find the gold, and he promises to be a much nicer principal at school. Everyone ends up happy, and the girls finally earn the respect of the adults in town.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves kid-detective stories and neighborhood mysteries.
